errors.text_span: and each slice also has its percentage and count labeled directly on the chart
errors.evidence: This statement is false. The slices are labeled with the category name and its percentage (e.g., "Medium (51.8%)"). The absolute counts (e.g., 725,892) are only present in the legend, not directly on the chart's slices.

errors.text_span: The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting with “Medium” and proceeding clockwise to the smallest “Very easy” slice.
errors.evidence: The description of the segment arrangement is incorrect. The clockwise order of slices starting from the top is: Very easy (4.7%), Very hard (6.5%), Easy (11.2%), Hard (25.7%), Medium (51.8%). This is an ascending order of size, not descending.
